summary: The episode opens discussing the Bybit $1B hack and counterparty risk in crypto. Duck and Cred view Bitcoin as range-bound between 95k-100k with 95k acting as strong support, though both express uncertainty about near-term direction given S&P correlation and Trump policy uncertainty. Duck is notably bearish on Solana, comparing SOL/BTC to ETH/BTC before its major decline, and suggests the meme coin sector on Solana has peaked. ETH shows improved character relative to its history. The hosts advise traders to keep their day jobs and avoid overtrading, noting meme coin odds have deteriorated significantly.
key_takeaways: BTC ranging 95k-100k with strong support at 95k; below 95k targets 90k
Solana viewed as bearish trade only - avoid long positions due to meme coin extraction overhang
Duck still believes in one more move up for crypto broadly (150k BTC, 6-7k ETH possible)
Meme coin sector has likely peaked - next wealth event needed on different chain to revive
Bybit hack highlights importance of counterparty risk management and not keeping all funds on one exchange
